title: Preset recovery and support workflows
summary: Integrated backend-owned PresetV2, lifecycle recovery, and redacted support-bundle workflows into existing operator pages.
reason: Make mature backend capabilities usable without moving persistence, lifecycle, redaction, or media policy into the WebView.
behavior_before: PresetV2 and support-export contracts existed without focused operator controls; recovery evidence was not surfaced as a compact Home/Diagnostics workflow.
behavior_after: Settings, Home/Diagnostics, and Maintenance call only documented backend routes, use strict confirmations supplied by explicit actions, and render sanitized evidence.
manual_validation: Focused unit/static suite passed: 22 tests covering PresetV2, support-export redaction, recovery, provenance contract, command ownership, and WebView integration.
rollback_plan: Remove the focused script tags and panels; backend contracts and state remain unchanged.
